content.text: Gou An in plain grey linen steadies the left side of the empty wooden grain cart. From behind the cart at human eye height, two hands in grey-brown linen sleeves enter the bottom of the frame and grasp its solid rear crossbar. Together they push forward slowly. The wooden wheels roll across a shallow rut and continue south. A single continuous 9 second historical live-action shot. Soft overcast daylight. Only wheel creaks, footsteps and quiet wind. No background music.
